svg.title: Stock and residual correlations in the December 2021 cohort

cc:Work.dc:title: Stock and residual correlations in the December 2021 cohort
cc:Work.dc:description: The same 850 stocks, eleven 2021 residual groups and tile boundaries are retained in each 252-session panel. Each tile averages pair correlations and excludes self-pairs. Forming windows use 2021-01-04 through 2021-12-31. The forward window uses 2022-01-03 through 2023-01-03. Stock returns are close-to-close percentage changes.
